title: The Kilimanjaro Marathon in Moshi
excerpt: The Kilimanjaro Marathon in Moshi is a race on the foot of Africa's highest mountain. What runners should know.
body:
## The race

The Kilimanjaro Marathon takes place in Moshi, usually early in the year. It offers a full marathon, a half marathon and shorter distances.

## Conditions

Moshi lies at about 800–900 m. It can be warm, and the course has climbs.

## Combine

Many runners combine the race with a safari, a [day hike](/blog/kilimanjaro-day-hike/) or a [Kilimanjaro climb](/climbing-kilimanjaro/).

## Check

Dates and registration change each year. Check the official website.

See [Moshi](/blog/moshi-town-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
